resolution.source_excerpt: Valid qualifying-stage results may be approved automatically, with at most six automatic ratifications overall and two per league in the inclusive rolling 24-hour window. Qualifying results beyond either cap go to human review. Every valid championship-stage result requires the league supervisor's human review. Counts are shared across that league's referees; creating a local client does not create more allowance. Explicit supervised execution follows approval. Request a stored Runner-ledger receipt and independently verify the changed source row. No match server or external system is contacted.
